reasons.plausibility: This hypothesis aligns well with known magnetoelastic effects in high-entropy alloys and the role of nanoscale strain but requires more evidence for the specific strain-coupling mechanism.
reasons.testability: The proposed systematic doping and thorough characterization provide a clear path to verify or refute the role of strain fields in enhancing the magnetocaloric effect.
reasons.usefulness: It offers a practical route to optimize rare-earth-free magnetocaloric alloys, addressing key performance metrics directly relevant to magnetic refrigeration.
